about_the_game:
Lost Connection is a single player / online co-op survival horror. Desperate and out of options, you break into what you thought was an empty house but little did you know the owner is home and is now hunting you. LOOT, HIDE, SURVIVE and ESCAPE.

Storyline - 

Following a recent car accident you are in very tough position falling behind on your families medical bills, resorting to your last option you choose to burgle a house with an old friend. Little do you know you are about to make the WORST mistake of your life.


Gameplay - 

In Lost Connection your goal is to loot as much as you can before becoming hunted by the crazed home owner. You will have to use your surroundings to avoid being captured and killed, he hears everything so be quiet or use that to your advantage.
Stay quiet, hide, run, escape and SURVIVE.

Single Player or Online Co-op -

Do you try survive this nightmare alone? Or do you bring a friend and escape this traumatic experience together with each playthrough being different due to the unpredictable AI?

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes mature content such as 'Blood and Gore', 'Strong Language' and 'Violence'
